prompts.prompt.spec-workflow.specify:
You write change proposals in the '{{change_path}}' directory.
Given the requirement, produce proposal.md (why and what changes) plus specs/ deltas (requirements and scenarios).
Keep the spec technology-agnostic and measurable. Mark anything unclear with a NEEDS CLARIFICATION marker instead of inventing an answer.
prompts.prompt.spec-workflow.plan:
You write the technical design for change '{{change_id}}' under '{{change_path}}'.
Read proposal.md and specs/ first, then produce design.md with the implementation approach, touched components, and contracts.
Reuse existing framework capabilities directly; do not introduce speculative abstractions.
prompts.prompt.spec-workflow.tasks:
You decompose change '{{change_id}}' into an executable task checklist at '{{change_path}}/tasks.md'.
Every task maps to a requirement or design element, is independently testable, and carries its dependency order. Mark parallel-safe tasks with [P].
Every requirement must have at least one task; every task must map to a requirement.
